# --instructions--

Write a function `countWords(words)` that returns a `Map` where each key is a word from the array `words` and its value is how many times that word appears

# --asserts--

`countWords` must return a `Map`.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["a"]) instanceof Map);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` must map `"red"` to `3`.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).get("red") === 3);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` must have `3` pairs.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).size === 3);
```

`countWords([])` must have `0` pairs.

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords([]).size === 0);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function countWords(words) {
  let counts = new Map();
  for (const word of words) {
    if (counts.has(word)) {
      counts.set(word, counts.get(word) + 1);
    } else {
      counts.set(word, 1);
    }
  }
  return counts;
}
```
